page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right. Mirrored show-through text in the lower left and along the left edge is left out.

main_text.p: impliciti caufam armorū contra se Romanis dederunt. A quibus bello trienni superati domitique, duce praecipuo Metello, qui ex eo Cretici nomen tulit, amissa libertate, & patriarum legum usu, provinciae formam accepere, ac deinceps jure Romano vivere necessum habuère. Abhinc aliquot secutis saeculis insula Romano imperio subjecta quievit ad tempora per totum mare mediterraneum grassantium Saracenorum, à quibus non semel graviter concussa & afflicta fuit. Demum cum à principibus Latinis ope praecipuâ Venetorum Byzantium esset occupatum, Creta in praemium navatae operae Venetis cessit. Quorum imperio, quanquàm saepè motâ contra eos rebellione, etiam nunc paret, mutatoque nomine pro Cretâ Candia audit, sic nuncupata ex maximâ, quae jam in ea floret, urbe, quae & coloniam Venetorum ad firmandum in totâ insulâ horum imperium jam pridem accepit, & praefidi Veneto, ac summo tribunali sedem praebet.

page.notes: Printed "Metello" is followed by a mark that may be a hyphen, transcribed as a comma. The page number is printed as "8o", the old form of 80. Two words are doubtful: "patriarum" and "necessum" are transcribed as printed, but the scan is faint at those points. Mirrored text in the lower left and along the left edge is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed.
